title: Operator Booking Detail and Traveller Operations
outcome: Approved operator staff can open one operator-owned booking and understand its travellers, occupancy, payment timeline, document readiness, visa progress and module-owned operational actions from one detail workspace.
actor: Approved operator staff responsible for servicing bookings and travellers.
modules: Booking owns booking and traveller facts, occupancy and booking lifecycle.
Payments owns payment attempts and instalment progress.
Documents owns document requirements and review state.
Operations modules retain ownership of support and cancellation actions.
Web composes read-only operational context and links to module-owned actions without bypassing domain boundaries.
routes: Booking detail -> support and cancellation workspaces
acceptance: An operator can open a booking from /operator/bookings using a real clickable control.
The detail endpoint and page are isolated to the active operator; foreign-operator booking IDs return safe not-found behavior.
Booking reference, package, dates, state, occupancy and traveller count are visible without changing booking state.
Each traveller is shown with identity-safe operational facts and current document and visa readiness where available.
Payment totals, paid amount, remaining amount and scheduled instalments are presented from existing payment and booking data without recalculating financial rules in the browser.
Document and visa actions deep-link to the existing module-owned queues or detail routes rather than duplicating mutation behavior.
Support and cancellation actions remain permission and lifecycle governed by their existing modules.
Loading, empty/not-found, forbidden and recoverable-error states are explicit.
Desktop and mobile navigation, keyboard operation, target size, reflow and serious/critical accessibility checks pass.
Existing staff shell, authorization policies and domain state machines are not redesigned or weakened.
Product Owner approval is required for the exact certified SHA before merge; deployment remains separately approved.
policyDecisionsRequired: Keep the booking detail workspace operational and read-oriented; mutations stay in module-owned workflows.
Show only identity-safe traveller facts required for operations.
Use the existing staff shell and NoorPath design system without structural redesign.
exclusions: New payment capture or refund execution.
Editing traveller identity or passport data outside existing governed flows.
Visa or document state transitions from the booking detail page.
New cancellation policy or support commands.
